## Overview

A centered, max-width content wrapper — the outermost layout primitive
for page sections.

## Properties

| Property   | Attribute   | Description                                           | Type                                              | Default |
| ---------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `center`   | `center`    | Centers the container horizontally within its parent. | `boolean`                                         | `true`  |
| `maxWidth` | `max-width` | Maximum width of the container.                       | `"2xl" \| "full" \| "lg" \| "md" \| "sm" \| "xl"` | `'lg'`  |
| `padding`  | `padding`   | Adds horizontal padding.                              | `boolean`                                         | `true`  |
